title: Rebling Quick Disconnect Plugs – Connector: Battery
description: Accommodates rapid connection and release of battery electrical load Four-wire design per MS25182–2 Mates with Rebling’s type 7002 aero-battery receptacles (and all others meeting MS3509) Corrosion resistant stainless steel shaft and fasteners QPL listed per MS25182–2 and MIL-P-18184
